info.title: SlopFizzBuzz Numerical Affairs API
info.description: The public proclamation and institutional assurance desks of The Serious Business Company, Inc. FizzBuzz output remains plain text. Operational verdicts are process-local unless stated otherwise. A passing internal control does not imply external certification. Every response carries X-SlopBuzz-Trace-Id and X-SlopBuzz-Span-Id receipts; a valid W3C traceparent request preserves its trace ID while the server issues a new span. The static showcase executes these business operations locally through the RuntimeClient interface; paths describe logical requests and are not HTTP listeners in browser mode. cURL examples apply to the optional Java server. Browser audit and cache use IndexedDB; server deployments use their configured H2/Redis adapters. See /operations/runtime for capabilities.

get.description: Runs the real Spring service for integers 1 through limit. A cache miss produces audit certificates; a Redis hit returns the same approved text without producing new certificates. A production start at 1 obtains a commencement certificate from seven personnel offices. X-SlopBuzz-Onboarding-Trace carries request-bound completed decisions without changing the plain-text body. Cache hits and later extended windows create no new HR proceedings.

200.description: One line per integer, or an empty body for zero.

Cache-Control.description: The HTTP response is never stored by the browser.

2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

get.summary: Inspect the certified glyph supply chain
get.description: Assembles Fizz, Buzz or FizzBuzz through the same procurement implementation used by production string returners. Each repeated character has its own position and certificate. This is an inspection demonstration, not a historical receipt: it creates no audit transactions and consumes no inventory. In browser mode the request executes locally and works offline.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Approved product, with exact case. Omit for FizzBuzz. Unknown, repeated or extra query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Certified assembly and individual receiving records.

400.description: Product is not authorized or query is malformed.

405.description: Only GET is authorized; Allow: GET.

get.summary: Disclose a finite window of arbitrary-magnitude ordinals
get.description: The extended web demo advances through finite windows starting at 1. Ordinal magnitude has no application cap. Output is generated by shared Java BigInteger and glyph procurement, with independent lexical inspection. These proceedings are transient: no retained audit entries or cache records are created. Each response contains 1–100 LF-terminated lines; this is a transport window limit, not an upper limit on the mandate. A production start at 1 obtains a commencement certificate from seven personnel offices. X-SlopBuzz-Onboarding-Trace carries request-bound completed decisions without changing the plain-text body. Cache hits and later extended windows create no new HR proceedings.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Positive decimal ordinal, transmitted as text to preserve precision.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of lines in this finite response window.

200.description: Exact plain-text lines; X-SlopBuzz-Proceedings: TRANSIENT; X-SlopBuzz-Cache: BYPASS.

400.description: Malformed query, non-positive start or invalid window count.

get.description: Forecasts the same proclamation mix as the standard capacity bureau, without an upper magnitude cap. Every numeric result is a decimal string so JSON parsing cannot round it. No proclamations or audit transactions are produced.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Non-negative decimal upper limit, supplied as text.

get.description: Executes the same seven Java authorities that govern the production loop origin. Approved hires candidate 1; zero and two fail identity review; missing-induction fails probation. A rejected application is a successful read-only rehearsal and returns HTTP 200 with status REJECTED. No output mandate, cache operation, audit transaction or external HR approval is created. The UI discloses these completed decisions at the selected reading speed; the business decisions have already run.

parameters.name: scenario
parameters.description: One exact, unencoded scenario. Omission defaults to approved; repeated or extra parameters are rejected.

200.description: Actual immutable rehearsal decisions, including offices not reached after rejection.

get.summary: Issue a mandate with actual execution proceedings
get.description: Opt-in structured envelope around one execution of /fizzbuzz. Returns the identical numerical text with bounded, request-local Java observations and optional actual personnel evidence. It does not rerun the operation for its story. Cache hits report only the cache action; extended windows do not invent retained transactions. The observer never grants business authorization. At most 50000 observations are retained; omitted counts are explicit. Older runtimes may lack this operation: clients must probe operations/runtime narrative capability before choosing an execution path, rather than retrying a possibly completed mandate.

200.description: Numerical result and the actual observed proceedings.

400.description: The original failure status is preserved with its text and observed failure record.

500.description: The original failure status is preserved with its text and observed failure record.

get.summary: Disclose a transient window with execution proceedings
get.description: Opt-in structured envelope around one execution of /fizzbuzz/window. Returns the identical numerical text with bounded, request-local Java observations and optional actual personnel evidence. It does not rerun the operation for its story. Cache hits report only the cache action; extended windows do not invent retained transactions. The observer never grants business authorization. At most 50000 observations are retained; omitted counts are explicit. Older runtimes may lack this operation: clients must probe operations/runtime narrative capability before choosing an execution path, rather than retrying a possibly completed mandate.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Positive decimal ordinal, transmitted as text to preserve precision.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of lines in this finite response window.

200.description: Numerical result and the actual observed proceedings.

400.description: The original failure status is preserved with its text and observed failure record.

500.description: The original failure status is preserved with its text and observed failure record.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Inclusive upper bound; defaults to 100. The query must be exactly limit followed by 1–4 decimal digits.

CacheDisposition.description: The Redis lookup decision for this request.

TraceId.description: A 16-byte lowercase hexadecimal trace receipt. A valid incoming W3C traceparent retains its trace ID.

SpanId.description: A new 8-byte lowercase hexadecimal span for this HTTP request.

PersonnelState.description: APPROVED or REJECTED describes an observed initializer call. CACHE_REUSED means no new onboarding. CONTINUATION means an extended window starts after 1. UNAVAILABLE means this implementation emitted no dossier; older runtimes may omit both headers.

PersonnelTrace.description: ASCII-escaped JSON PersonnelDossier, at most 8192 characters, captured from this request’s actual Java initializer. Only supplied when onboarding ran. Never copied into the output cache or persisted in the numerical journal. Missing on cache hits and extended continuation windows. See PersonnelDossier schema.

InvalidLimit.description: Limit syntax or range was rejected.

text/plain.example: Invalid limit; use an integer from 0 through 1000

revision.description: Declared full Git SHA, or unknown outside a stamped deployment.

durable.description: True only for a file-backed H2 URL.

storedEntries.description: -1 means the store could not be read.

text.description: Certified characters in purchasing order; excludes the proclamation line ending.

caseId.description: HR- followed by the request trace ID. Display reference; object custody, rather than this label, binds the Java documents.

purpose.description: Mandate evidence is captured from the actual initializer call. Rehearsals are separate read-only exercises.

startingOrdinal.description: The independently audited ordinal, or null when no clearance was granted.

steps.description: Headcount Planning, Recruitment, Identity Office, Offer Authority, Induction, Probation Review, Independent Audit, in execution order.

state.description: An actual completed office decision. After rejection later offices have no decision and no issued document.

rule.description: The published prerequisite applied by this office.

received.description: The preceding evidence presented for review.

finding.description: The authority’s reason for approval, rejection, or not being reached.

document.description: Human-readable summary of the immutable Java document or rejection notice.

text.description: Exactly the original proclamation body, including line endings, or the original error text.

personnel.description: Observed personnel decisions from this execution, or null when no such record was produced.

omitted.description: Number of observations beyond the finite collector allowance.

ordinal.description: Exact decimal ordinal, or null for a request-wide action. Strings preserve arbitrary precision.

kind.description: Semantic action actually observed: for example CACHE_MISS, HR_APPROVED, CLASSIFICATION, GLYPH_ACCEPTED, NOTARY, AUDIT_APPEND or EXTENDED_NOTARY.

office.description: The authority or component that performed the action.

finding.description: Observed inputs, outcome and reason. Observations describe completed acts; they are not authorizations.

document.description: Actual payload or document summary when one was emitted.
